hooks.command: file=$(echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | jq -r '.file_path // empty'); if [[ "$file" == */service/base/*Base.java ]] && [[ "$file" == */modules/* ]]; then echo "BLOCK: $file is a generated Service Builder base class — edit the *Impl instead, or run buildService to regenerate."; exit 2; fi

file=$(echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | jq -r '.file_path // empty'); if [[ "$file" == *.java ]] && [[ "$file" != */modules/* ]]; then cd /opt/projects/liferay/portal/arena-7.4.3.129-ga129/portal && ant compile 2>&1 | grep -E '(error:|BUILD FAILED|BUILD SUCCEEDED|\[javac\])' | tail -20; fi
